paragraphs: Pray for one another: Thanksgiving and Requests
Sing a song of praise together
Review & Accountability
To whom did you tell Jesus’ story?
Have someone teach the “Hand Gospel”
What was the topic of the last lesson? What did you learn?
(Go and Make Disciples)

sections.title: Look Up (New Teaching)
paragraphs: Ever since Jesus came into the world, people have encountered persecution because of their faith in Him. But following Jesus is worth it! Today, we will learn what God’s Word says about facing persecution.
Read
Matthew 5:10-12
John 16:33
Acts 4:1-31 (Peter & John’s Boldness)
Tell It as a Story
Can someone tell this story in their own words?
Practice in groups of two.
Teach
Peter and John were common, uneducated men that did God’s work.
When we are persecuted, Jesus says that we will receive an eternal reward.
Persecution will come to all who follow Jesus.
Just as Peter and John did, we must obey God instead of man when persecution comes.
God is with us when persecution comes.
We should pray for boldness.
Ask
What did you learn from these Scriptures?
Think a little, how will you practice what you have learned?

sections.title: Look Forward (Obedience)
paragraphs: Make a Plan
Make a plan to go to a new village that does not know Jesus and look for people of peace.
If someone chooses to follow Jesus, then start teaching him or her how to tell Jesus’ story (the Gospel).
Take a believer with you as you go out so that they can learn.
To whom will you tell your testimony and Jesus’ story?
Vision Casting
God loves all people and desires that they know Him. Let’s commit to make disciples among all people.
Matthew 28:19-20
Pray
Ask God to help each of us with boldness as we face persecution from the world.
